resources.string: We check the APKs, links and apps you choose against trusted sources.
No scans yet. Pick one of the options above.
Add API keys in Settings. Without keys only on-device analysis works.
The app only scans files and links you choose; there is no background real-time protection.
“No threats detected” is not a 100% safety guarantee.
Install apps from official sources such as Google Play whenever possible.
Be careful with APKs from SMS, Telegram or unknown websites.
What does APK Qo‘riqchi AI do?
Checks APK files before you install them using VirusTotal and on-device analysis.
Checks links against phishing and malware site databases.
Reviews installed apps’ permissions and install source, and AI explains the result in plain language.
This app does not replace Google Play Protect or Android’s built-in security – keep them on.
Only files and links you choose are checked; there is no background real-time protection.
“No threats detected” is not a 100% safety guarantee.
Only file hashes and URLs are sent to providers.
Files themselves are uploaded to VirusTotal only with your explicit consent.
API keys are stored encrypted on the device; we have no server.
You can delete history and keys in Settings at any time.
